KNIFEHERO-MENDED_BODY.title: Mended Body
KNIFEHERO-MENDED_BODY.description: At the start of each combat, gain Wholeness equal to your number of Mended Hearts. "The body you refused to abandon."
KNIFEHERO-MENDED_BODY.flavor: Every part you made whole is still a part of you.
KNIFEHERO-THE_WASH.title: The Wash
KNIFEHERO-THE_WASH.description: Whenever you play a Strike or a Defend, it becomes a Switch Blade.
